purpose: Release validation gates required before a version can be promoted to public projection.

mandatory.name: secret_lint
mandatory.description: No secrets, tokens, or credentials in source

mandatory.name: architecture_boundary
mandatory.description: Crate boundaries and DAG invariants preserved

optional.name: builder_validation
optional.reference: CYNIC builder as SSOT for build validation

stages.name: optional_artifact_build
stages.on_failure: block release if artifacts required, otherwise warn

architecture_conformant.description: Crate boundaries and DAG invariants preserved

artifact_integrity.description: Release artifacts have valid SHA-256 checksums

rules.rule: All mandatory gates must pass before a release tag is created on forgejo/main.
notes: Mandatory gates: cargo check, tests, secret lint, architecture boundary
Failure of any mandatory gate blocks the release

rules.rule: Optional gates (build_release, builder_validation) can be enabled/disabled based on release requirements.
notes: Build release required for binary distribution releases
Builder validation recommended for production releases

rules.rule: Build and validation metrics are tracked for each release for audit and trend analysis.
notes: Metrics: build green, tests green, secrets clean, architecture conformant, artifact integrity
All thresholds are 100% pass or 0 findings as appropriate

rules.rule: Gate results are persisted as machine-readable evidence, not just console output.
notes: Evidence stored for release audit trail
